Cart is the add-to-bag flow of a store: AddToCartButton on the product page, CartTrigger in the header, and CartDrawer, which slides in from the right on desktop and up from the bottom on phones. CartPanel shows the same cart as a full page.

Each stepper is a labelled group with “Decrease quantity of Ring Vase”, “Increase quantity of Ring Vase” and a numeric text field that selects its value on focus. Failed updates are announced with role alert.

Every change applies at once. Pressing plus updates the quantity, line total and subtotal straight away, and the request runs behind it. Quick presses are merged into one request for the final quantity. If your callback throws, the line goes back to the last confirmed quantity and shows your message, such as “Only 2 left in Sand / Large”. The same logic is exported as useOptimisticCart for your own layouts.

Removing a line collapses it into a “Removed Ring Vase · Undo” row for five seconds, and the lines below slide up. Undo puts the line back where it was. Lines can also show that their price changed since they were added, or that they sold out, which blocks checkout until they are removed.
